mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER_NOTICES (ALARM_ID, USER_ID, NOTICE_ID, ALERT_TYPE, TARGET_TYPE, TARGET_ID, IS_READ, REG_DT) VALUES (SEQ_ALARM_ID.NEXTVAL, #{userId}, #{noticeId}, 'NOTICE', 'NOTICE', #{noticeId}, 'N', SYSDATE)

INSERT INTO USER_NOTICES ( ALARM_ID, USER_ID, NOTICE_ID, ALERT_TYPE, TARGET_TYPE, TARGET_ID, TITLE, CONTENT, LINK_URL, IS_READ, REG_DT ) VALUES ( SEQ_ALARM_ID.NEXTVAL, #{userId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, NULL, 'CALENDAR_ATTENDEE', 'CALENDAR', #{targetId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{title, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{content, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{linkUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'N', SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT A.ALARM_ID AS alarmId, A.USER_ID AS userId, A.NOTICE_ID AS noticeId, NVL(A.ALERT_TYPE, 'NOTICE') AS alertType, NVL(A.TARGET_TYPE, CASE WHEN A.NOTICE_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'NOTICE' ELSE NULL END) AS targetType, NVL(A.TARGET_ID, A.NOTICE_ID) AS targetId, COALESCE(A.TITLE, N.TITLE, '새 알림') AS title, COALESCE(A.CONTENT, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(N.CONTENT, 1000, 1)) AS content, A.LINK_URL AS linkUrl, A.IS_READ AS isRead, A.REG_DT AS regDt FROM USER_NOTICES A LEFT JOIN SYSTEM_NOTICES N ON A.NOTICE_ID = N.NOTICE_ID WHERE A.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY A.REG_DT DESC
